assignmentHtml.task: Research Baby Shark - Pinkfong Kids' Songs & Stories YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: SmartStudy / Pinkfong. Corporate chain. When was Pinkfong acquired by SmartStudy? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category (children's nursery rhymes/animation). (7) Content supply model: original/commissioned animation. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Baby Shark - Pinkfong Kids' Songs & Stories is #43 with ~57B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Baby Shark - Pinkfong Kids' Songs & Stories with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml: Dossier for Baby Shark - Pinkfong Kids' Songs & Stories YouTube channel

evidence.snippet: Channel title: 'Baby Shark - Pinkfong Kids' Songs & Stories'. Channel ID embedded in URL: UCcdwLMPsaU2ezNSJU1nFoBQ. Handle: @pinkfong.
evidence.supports: Stable channel ID UCcdwLMPsaU2ezNSJU1nFoBQ and canonical URL https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcdwLMPsaU2ezNSJU1nFoBQ confirmed.

evidence.snippet: The Pinkfong Company (Korean: 더핑크퐁컴퍼니) previously known as SmartStudy and Smart Books Media, is a South Korean entertainment company. Their brands and intellectual property include Pinkfong and Baby Shark... On January 6, 2022, they changed their corporate name to The Pinkfong Company. Founded June 2010... by CEO Kim Min-seok... Samsung Publishing Company Ltd., The Pinkfong Company's parent company.
evidence.supports: Corporate chain: SmartStudy/Smart Books Media (founded June 2010) → created Pinkfong brand in-house → renamed to The Pinkfong Company Jan 6, 2022. Not an acquisition; rebranding of same entity. Parent: Samsung Publishing Co. Ltd.

evidence.snippet: Subscribers: 85M | Views: 57B | Videos: 4K | Created On: Dec 14, 2011.
evidence.supports: Channel creation date December 14, 2011, confirmed by Social Blade.

evidence.snippet: The original music video for 'Baby Shark' without child actors was uploaded on November 25, 2015. The most popular version of Pinkfong's videos, 'Baby Shark Dance', was uploaded on June 17, 2016.
evidence.supports: Earliest Baby Shark-related video still public is the Nov 25, 2015 upload. Earlier Babyfong/Kidfong-era videos (2011-2014) were largely made private by the company.

evidence.snippet: Pinkfong is a creator... based in United States... Niche: Kids & Education... Posts in English... Is Pinkfong originally from South Korea? Yes... Although the YouTube channel is registered in the United States, the brand's creative roots and founding team are Korean.
evidence.supports: Displayed country: United States (channel registered in US, likely LA branch). Operating location: HQ Seoul, South Korea; offices in LA, Tokyo, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore. Primary language: English.

evidence.snippet: Pinkfong is an English-language South Korean children's educational brand... Pinkfong content consists mainly of children's songs... Their channel consists of songs, stories, and dances that are represented by a pink fox named Pinkfong... focus is children aged 1-5... By 2018, the company has more than 4,000 kids' songs, stories, video games and merchandise.
evidence.supports: Primary content category: children's nursery rhymes/animation for ages 1-5. Language: English (primary). Languages of localized channels: 40+ languages including Korean, Japanese, Spanish, Mandarin, Thai, Russian, Arabic, Hindi.

evidence.snippet: The Pinkfong Company is focusing on the development of content and brand new original IPs... Moon Shark is co-produced with M Story Hub... Baby Shark's Big Show!, the preschool series co-produced with Nickelodeon Animation Studio... The Pinkfong Company gears up to expand its presence globally.
evidence.supports: Content supply model: primarily original/in-house IP development (Baby Shark, Bebefinn, Hogi), with selective co-productions (Nickelodeon Animation Studio, M Story Hub).

evidence.snippet: Top songs: 'Baby Shark, More and More' - 20B plays; 'Monkey Banana' - 871M plays; 'Boo Boo Song' - 87M plays; 'New Baby Shark' - 1.2B plays; 'Sí, Papá' - 474M plays. Albums include Hogi Bilingual Learning Songs, Pinkfong Fall Songs, Baby Shark Nursery Rhymes Fun.
evidence.supports: Representative works: Baby Shark franchise (More and More, New Baby Shark), Monkey Banana, Boo Boo Song, Sí Papá. Also Piggy and Toppy, Hogi's Playground, Bebefinn series.

evidence.snippet: 'Baby Shark Dance' was the fifth video to reach 4 billion views... the first to reach 10 billion views on January 13, 2022... 17,179,869,184 views (2^34) on August 2, 2026.
evidence.supports: Baby Shark Dance is the most-viewed YouTube video ever with ~17.18B views as of Aug 2026. Upload date June 17, 2016.

evidence.snippet: Nationality: South Korean. Location: Seocho-dong, Seoul, South Korea. Style: Animation. The website link is a Korean domain, but the country listed on the channel claims it's from the United States. It's possible the main channel is managed by the Los Angeles branch.
evidence.supports: Displayed country: United States. Operating HQ: Seoul, South Korea. Content style: Animation. Handles localized versions in 40+ languages.
